login.title: From source documents to traceable emission data
login.body: Log in once through Keycloak. The token carries your company (tenant); the gateway and every service verify it again.
login.hint: Demo accounts: alice (Company A – steel) or bob (Company B – logistics).
config.accepts: Your company's configuration accepts {count} document types:
upload.title: Upload a document
upload.drop: Drop or click to choose a PDF / image (up to 10 MB)
samples.title: Sample documents
samples.empty: No sample documents for this company.
pipeline.title: Processing pipeline
pipeline.idle: Upload a document to see each step.
step.gateway: Gateway verifies the token (JWT) and tenant
step.store: Original file stored in the company's own storage
step.classify: AI classifies the document using the company's configuration
step.extract: AI extracts fields with a confidence score
step.persist: Results saved and linked to the original document
result.unknown: Not one of the configured document types
documents.title: Company documents
facilities.title: Company facilities
facilities.body: Read through GraphQL (Hasura) behind the gateway; each company only sees its own data.
error.session: Your session has expired, please log in again.
